introText: The Samba Solar Track controller works on its own. This adapter shows its state, receives its messages and passes on commands and settings.
ipHelp: IP address or host name, shown at the display under setup > network
tokenText: Token for the adapter: the display shows it under gear > NETZWERK, heading "TOKEN FUER DEN ADAPTER", as 4 blocks of 8 characters (0-9, a-f): blocks 1 and 2 in the first line, 3 and 4 in the second. Enter them from left to right. The entry is hidden; the eye shows it. Without a token the adapter only reads; commands and settings need it.
tokenBlockError: Each block needs 8 characters (0-9, a-f); otherwise leave all four fields empty
forwardLevelLabel: Write messages of the device to the ioBroker log
forwardLevelHelp: All messages are stored in the states under messages, whatever is chosen here
historySizeHelp: Number of messages kept in messages.history (1 to 500)
messagingInstanceHelp: Instance of a messaging adapter, for example Telegram, Pushover or e-mail
notifyFaultLabel: Faults (runtime of a drive, switching outputs)
notifyWindLabel: Wind sensor stops answering or answers again
notifySensorLabel: Sun sensor reports a fault or works again
notifyConnectionLabel: Device not reachable or reachable again
notifyConnectionMinutesHelp: A short interruption of the WLAN causes no notification (1 to 1440)
